index.description: News that changes where you book a table in Finnish Lapland. Every story is written from the original source, which is named, dated and linked.
index.lead: What is opening, changing and closing in Lapland restaurants, written from the original sources. Every story names and links what it is based on.
index.aboutText: We open every source before writing and report only what it says. Where a price, an opening date or an opening hour is missing from the source, we say so instead of filling the gap.
